purpose: Find and repair actual original Sol extraction misses, with a blind retry control. No model training or downstream training destination.
origin: Fresh deterministic fictional procurement records rendered by code authored by agents; no live model writes a test document or answer key.

models.snapshot_limit: Official catalog exposes this model ID rather than an immutable dated snapshot; preserve CLI metadata and cached responses.
Official catalog exposes this model ID rather than an immutable dated snapshot; preserve CLI metadata and cached responses.

date_filter: All fixture instances are newly generated on or after 2026-10-24, later than both documented model knowledge cutoffs. No historical public examples are used as targets.
dates_note: Fixture creation dates use the local run date. Document timestamps are fictional task content; raw calls include UTC timestamps.
truth: Separate procedural/Decimal and grouped/Fraction implementations agree. Six rendered prototype packs were independently reviewed by Luna before calls; later measured-error reviews are saved separately. Reviews are by agents, not human annotators.

inference.limit: This bounded extraction setting does not measure maximum possible model performance.

repair_feedback: Oracle failed-field/category flags and original Sol output, but no gold values or gold citations. This is externally verified correction, not intrinsic self-correction.
treatment_budget: Each selected case gets one blind Sol retry, one verifier-assisted Sol repair and one Luna repair. Calls match, token/computation budgets do not.

source_freeze.inference: Codex CLI, low reasoning, no tools, batches of two
source_freeze.test_scope: 16 fixture tests and 6 pipeline tests; no live model responses used by tests
source_freeze.prior_source_review: Six rendered level-one source packs checked by Luna; all labels matched.

historical_data: All earlier v1 and hard_v2 data and figures are retained byte-for-byte.
rights_note: Code and narrative follow the repository MIT license. Model responses are identified as generated service outputs. This demonstration makes no claim of unrestricted permission to use exported responses for training other models.

new_source.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
new_source.connection: Studies intrinsic correction without external feedback; our failed-field feedback makes this a different intervention.

spend_note: Token usage is recorded by the subscription CLI; no dollar amount is reported. Unknown is not zero.
